informal_restatement.author: Formalia 维护者（据 formal-conjectures 文档注释翻译）
informal_restatement.text: 从任意非空有限整数序列出发，不断在末尾添上它的卷曲数，最终会得到卷曲数为 1 的序列（Chaffin 与 Sloane 的猜想 1）。
informal_restatement.text_en:
Starting from any nonempty finite integer sequence, repeatedly appending its curling number
eventually gives a sequence with curling number $1$ [Chaffin and Sloane, Conjecture 1].
